Definition: from G1364 and G2281; having two seas, i.e. a sound with a double outlet:--where two seas meet.
BiblicalUsage: Where two seas meet, the place of two seas, the reef where Paul's ship struck and broke apart on the way to Malta.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God's purpose held even when the ship did not, because every soul aboard came safe to land.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
